mathematical_definition: Rolling Hurst exponent (rescaled-range method, numba kernel features.hurst.rolling_hurst) of ret1 over a trailing 120-bar window: log(R/S) / log(n), NaN when the trailing window's std or rescaled range R is below 1e-12 (degenerate near-constant window)
numerical_stability_notes: NaN when trailing std < 1e-12 or rescaled range R < 1e-12 (degenerate near-constant window guard inside the numba kernel)
missing_value_policy: NaN for the first 120 bars, and whenever the trailing window is degenerate (std<1e-12 or range<1e-12), never zero-filled
